page_title: MAI 0-0 PAU | Mainz v St. Pauli 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
90+3' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) produced a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Nikola Vasilj thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
90+1' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Nadiem Amiri and he is replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage leaves the pitch and is replaced by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
89' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
87' The resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared.
86' An attempted cross from Paul Nebel (Mainz) is cleared. Mainz earn a corner.
85' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and it's Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
82' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
81' Danny da Costa (Mainz) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
79' Urs Fischer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) replacing Silvan Widmer.
78' Benedict Hollerbach goes off the pitch and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) comes on.
76' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matthias Jollenbeck no option but to blow his whistle.
74' Substitution. Louis Oppie makes way for Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli).
73' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
73' The attendance for today's match is 33305.
71' St. Pauli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
68' Nikola Vasilj is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz). Easy save!
66' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
62' A yellow card for a tackle by Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli). Matthias Jollenbeck doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
58' The game has come to an end for Andreas Hountondji. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli).
57' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
55' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Silvan Widmer (Mainz) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
53' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from St. Pauli.
47' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Matthias Jollenbeck has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
44' The ball is cleared after Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
43' Great teamplay by Mainz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
41' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
40' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is intercepted by the defence.
40' The free kick is taken by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), but ball is cleared. Now Mainz have a corner.
39' Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul after Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Mainz, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
37' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
36' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
35' Matthias Jollenbeck blows the whistle, Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to St. Pauli.
35' Mainz fail to score from a corner as Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) leaps to collect the ball.
34' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) is booked.
31' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) commits a foul and Matthias Jollenbeck immediately signals a free kick.
31' 0:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
28' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is hurriedly cleared.
27' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Mainz can continue in their attacking effort.
26' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
21' The free kick is delivered by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
18' The corner is swung in but St. Pauli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
17' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee blows his whistle, St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
16' The Mainz players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
15' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
12' The free kick from long range, taken by St. Pauli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

11' Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. It's a free kick to St. Pauli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
10' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
9' St. Pauli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. St. Pauli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

8' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. St. Pauli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Danny da Costa (Mainz) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals.
3' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
